name: Zimeldine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1983 — for liver harm and nerve and brain harm

summary: Zimeldine was removed from the market worldwide starting in 1983 due to liver damage and neurotoxicity, which means harm to the nervous system [3]. In addition, a small computer model calculated scores for the drug's effects rather than relying on tests in people [M]. This computer model placed both the drug's liver score of 44 and heart score of 35 into a low band [M].
